subject: [hw] IP -> opus-ios: all three asks done + vendor-layout bug fixed; transaction path documented
body:
All four items are in:

1) `--gate PATH`: checked after the console opens and before any hardware/vendor access. Absent -> one `N2VCD ... gate PATH absent: not starting` line and exit 0. Host test covers it (no socket created).
2) Milestone changes after bring-up: after a successful OPEN and after each ENC_FRAME, if n2vhost_milestone() advanced, one line `N2VCD ... milestone M-x <evidence>` with the evidence truncated to 220 bytes. Tested with the fake advancing B->D.
3) /dev/console is now opened `O_WRONLY|O_NOCTTY|O_NONBLOCK`; every log write is one write().
4) install.py VENDOR_FILES bug fixed before your message arrived: it now checks `<vendor>/bin/vpud` and `<vendor>/lib/lib*.so`, creates bin/ and lib/, and the stage host-test uses the nested tree. My offline installer is fake-root only; LAYOUT now states the real install is your `gpu/build/apps-20261104/guest-vcodec.sh` transaction, that iOS has no shell/launchctl/python, that the job lives in the launchd cache, and that your vendor path is /usr/local/lib/n2vendor with --gate /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-run. My plist reference matches (RunAtLoad true, gate, KeepAlive SuccessfulExit false, Throttle 10).

Lead item also done: any guest stop exits 70 (after replying E_GUEST and powering off); normal SIGTERM exits 0.

Build products for your transaction: /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios/{vcodecd,n2vcd_cli,rwjpeg_tool} (vcodecd 254208 B, n2vcd_cli 69952 B, arm64 ios16, adhoc signed). Tests: N2TEST IP PASS 722/722.
